C - Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
|
|-- Request entry
|   `-- handleAgentRoutes -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService.call()
|       |-- Validate arguments against agentToolSchemas
|       |-- Deduplicate requestId / reject changed retries
|       `-- Route to execution, reading, or lifecycle operations
|
|-- Execute diagram changes
|   |
|   |-- Direct operations
|   |   |-- QuickJsAgentRuntime.run(): restricted JavaScript
|   |   |   |-- Validate canvas / nodes / edges methods
|   |   |   |-- Resolve sessionId to canvasId + documentId
|   |   |   `-- Produce DiagramOperation values
|   |   |
|   |   `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService.apply(): select target
|   |       |-- Live canvas
|   |       |   `-- CanvasSessionBridge.dispatch()                            -> bridge
|   |       |       |-- Queue a CanvasCommand for the document
|   |       |       |-- Browser polls -> handleAgentCommand() executes
|   |       |       `-- Browser posts /reply -> resolve waiting request
|   |       |
|   |       `-- Isolated proposal
|   |           `-- ChangeSessionService.apply()
|   |               `-- MappingDocumentController.applyUpdate()
|   |                   `-- Check expectedVersion -> apply -> persist preview
|   |
|   |-- Prompt-driven editing
|   |   `-- DiagramEditService
|   |       |-- Generate and apply revision
|   |       |-- Track progress / cancellation
|   |       `-- Retain generated revision for application retry
|   |
|   `-- Mutation contract
|       |-- Each exec mutation commits with its own undo step
|       |-- Earlier commits survive a later script failure
|       `-- sessionId identifies attachment; expectedVersion guards edits
|
|-- Read and synchronize live state
|   |
|   |-- Diagram reads
|   |   `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService.search()
|   |       |-- Live -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService.snapshot()
|   |       |   `-- Capture snapshot through CanvasSessionBridge              -> bridge
|   |       `-- Saved -> representation catalog
|   |
|   |-- Browser state and readers
|   |   `-- LiveCanvasService
|   |       |-- Publisher registration / disconnection
|   |       |-- Selection snapshots / deltas -> notify readers
|   |       |-- Reader attachment / invalidation; document + canvasEpoch
|   |       |-- Fresh nodes / edges / version; project API handles
|   |       |-- context() / contextForCanvas() / shortContextForCanvas()
|   |       `-- Copy / paste dispatch; paste checks expectedVersion
|   |
|   `-- Agent context
|       `-- AgentContextService
|           `-- Validate reader -> store trajectory for editing
|
|-- Manage proposals and durable state
|   |
|   |-- Proposal lifecycle
|   |   `-- ChangeSessionService
|   |       |-- Create isolated copies from saved canvases / live drafts
|   |       |-- Update metadata / review state / undo / redo / reset
|   |       `-- Accept proposal
|   |           |-- Check session version and original revisions
|   |           `-- Publish canvases together -> retain review history
|   |
|   |-- Diagram publication
|   |   `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService.save()
|   |       `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService.saveNow()
|   |           |-- Capture live snapshot through CanvasSessionBridge         -> bridge
|   |           `-- MappingDiagramService.save()
|   |               `-- Write catalog revision -> acknowledge browser
|   |
|   `-- Workspace persistence
|       `-- MappingWorkspaceService
|           |-- loadRecords() / applyBatch(): atomic record batches
|           `-- load() / save(): complete workspace snapshots
|
`-- Run application features
    |-- SelectionService          /prompt: generation / patch
    |-- LocalChatService          /chat: local chat
    |-- FileCompactionService     /compactions: run / get
    `-- MappingDiagramService     /diagrams: save / delete
